Performance

---

### Life of a project

#### 2019

[Shapely is a bottleneck]{.fragment}

---

### Optionally supported in GeoPandas in 2020

[Shapely was no longer needed]{.fragment}

[Huge transition effort would be needed]{.fragment}

---

### PyGEOS merged into Shapely in 2021

[Shapely 2.0 was PyGEOS with backwards compatibility]{.fragment}

merge into another project
